+    def _is_all_or_any_call(self, call):
+        """Check if a call is to all() or any()"""
+        if isinstance(call.func, ast.Name):
+            return call.func.id in ('all', 'any')
+        return False
+
+    def _has_unrollable_iterable(self, call):
+        """Check if the call has a generator expression or comprehension"""
+        if len(call.args) != 1 or call.keywords:
+            return False
+        arg = call.args[0]
+        return isinstance(arg, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp))
+
+    def visit_all_or_any(self, call):
+        """
+        Handle all() and any() calls with generator expressions or comprehensions.
+        
+        Unrolls the iterable to provide better error messages.
+        """
+        func_name = call.func.id  # 'all' or 'any'
+        arg = call.args[0]
+        
+        # Extract the element expression and generators
+        if isinstance(arg, ast.GeneratorExp):
+            elt = arg.elt
+            generators = arg.generators
+        elif isinstance(arg, ast.ListComp):
+            elt = arg.elt
+            generators = arg.generators
+        elif isinstance(arg, ast.SetComp):
+            elt = arg.elt
+            generators = arg.generators
+        else:
+            # Not a comprehension, fall back to default handling
+            return None
+        
+        # For now, we only handle single generators (no nested loops)
+        if len(generators) != 1:
+            return None
+        
+        comp = generators[0]
+        
+        # Create a variable to store the result
+        result_var = self.variable()
+        
+        # Initialize the result variable
+        if func_name == 'all':
+            init_value = _NameConstant(True)
+        else:  # any
+            init_value = _NameConstant(False)
+        
+        self.statements.append(
+            ast.Assign([ast.Name(result_var, ast.Store())], init_value)
+        )
+        
+        # Create the for loop
+        loop_var = self.variable()
+        loop_body = []
+        
+        # Visit the element expression
+        elt_res, elt_expl = self.visit(elt)
+        
+        # Create the if statement
+        if func_name == 'all':
+            # If not test, set result to False and break
+            loop_body.append(
+                ast.If(
+                    ast.UnaryOp(ast.Not(), elt_res),
+                    [
+                        ast.Assign([ast.Name(result_var, ast.Store())], _NameConstant(False)),
+                        ast.Break()
+                    ],
+                    []
+                )
+            )
+        else:  # any
+            # If test, set result to True and break
+            loop_body.append(
+                ast.If(
+                    elt_res,
+                    [
+                        ast.Assign([ast.Name(result_var, ast.Store())], _NameConstant(True)),
+                        ast.Break()
+                    ],
+                    []
+                )
+            )
+        
+        # Visit the iterator
+        iter_res, iter_expl = self.visit(comp.iter)
+        
+        # Create the for loop
+        for_loop = ast.For(
+            ast.Name(loop_var, ast.Store()),
+            iter_res,
+            loop_body,
+            []
+        )
+        
+        self.statements.append(for_loop)
+        
+        # Return the result variable
+        res = ast.Name(result_var, ast.Load())
+        res_expl = self.explanation_param(self.display(res))
+        return res, res_expl
+
